scope.note: Phase 1 needs only one dependable basic piano voice played from the keybed. Everything else in this file is Phase 2 scope. Items under excluded are never required in any phase; their panel controls exist visually but stay decorative and are listed as unsupported.
required: Two layers (A, B) with enable, focus, level fader, and octave shift
All six piano types selectable with at least one model each
Recorded, bundled, redistributable sample sets for Grand, Upright, and Electric
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res
Sustain pedal input (UI control, keyboard mapping, and MIDI CC64)
Truthful loading/ready/error state and a labeled playable fallback
optional: More than one model per type and the model list view
Soft and sostenuto pedal behavior (honest approximation allowed, must be labeled)
Pedal-down string resonance samples (simulated sympathetic resonance is sufficient)
excluded: Nord Triple Pedal hardware modeling and pedal-type configuration
Piano size classes (Sml/Med/Lrg/XL), INFO view, and Nord Sound Manager downloads
Piano preset library (cut benchmark-wide; see programs spec)

architecture.sectionOnButton: Turns the whole Piano section on or off.
architecture.sustainPedalPerSection: SUSTPED toggle routes the sustain input to this section (manual p. 23).
architecture.pitchStickPerSection: PSTICK toggle lets the pitch stick bend this section ±2 semitones (manual p. 23).

sourceRules.Grand: Recorded acoustic grand sample set (bundled, redistributable, offline).
sourceRules.Upright: Recorded acoustic upright sample set, audibly distinct from the grand.
sourceRules.Electric: Recorded tine or reed electric piano sample set.
sourceRules.Clav: Clavinet or harpsichord character; honest synthesis is acceptable.
sourceRules.Digital: Digital piano or layered piano character; honest synthesis is acceptable.
sourceRules.Misc: Mallet character such as marimba or vibraphone; honest synthesis is acceptable.

selection.sampleQuality: Use enough root notes and velocity variation that uniform pitch-shifting of one note is not audible. Declare every file, source, license, root note, and velocity layer in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json.
selection.missingModelState: If a model fails to load, the type LED flashes and the Program display reports the failure; a labeled fallback stays playable (manual p. 24).

performance.dynCompBehavior: Raises the level of softer strokes, narrowing dynamic range without changing timbre response (manual p. 25).
performance.unisonBehavior: Detuned stereo voices; 1 is subtle, 3 is wide and obviously detuned (manual p. 26).
performance.sustain: Full sustain with damper-up cutoff; applies per enabled layer when SUSTPED is on.

acoustics.softRelease: Slightly longer, less pronounced note release; disabled for Clav-type sounds (manual p. 25).
acoustics.stringRes: Sympathetic string resonance while other notes or the sustain pedal are held; simulation is acceptable (manual p. 25).

timbre.behavior: Soft dampens highs, Mid emphasizes midrange presence, Bright emphasizes treble; Dyno settings are preamp/EQ emulations for tine pianos (manual p. 26).

acceptance: Both layers can be enabled, focused, leveled, octave-shifted, and played independently with correct voice ownership.
All six types select a playable model; Grand, Upright, and Electric are recorded samples and audibly distinct from each other.
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, and String Res each measurably change rendered audio and are reflected in canonical state and panel feedback.
Sustain works from UI, computer keyboard, and MIDI CC64, and only affects layers with SUSTPED on.
Sample provenance is complete and truthful; generated sources are never described as recordings.
